suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53914 is a Kotlin compiler/build-cache deserialization vulnerability (unsafe deserialization of build-cache metadata, exploitable via IDE/CI tooling that reads the cache). kotlin-stdlib is a pure runtime library with no build-cache code path, so it cannot be affected. Here it's a transitive dependency of resilience4j-core (Kotlin-authored) in api-gateway, present only as a runtime library, not the compiler. No kotlin-stdlib release addressing this CPE match exists on Maven Central to upgrade to. (#105)

CVE-2026-41717 (SpEL injection via @Query capture-all placeholder) and CVE-2026-41696 (regex-binding injection via @Query), both Spring Data MongoDB advisories, are flagged against org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-data-mongodb:4.1.0 — a thin Spring Boot autoconfiguration wrapper whose version tracks Spring Boot's own release train, not Spring Data MongoDB's. Both CPE-match the vulnerable spring_data_mongodb ranges purely by coincidence of the version number (both list a "4.1.0-4.1.14" affected range). The actual org.springframework.data:spring-data-mongodb artifact this wrapper pulls in resolves to 5.1.0, outside every affected range in both advisories (5.0.0-5.0.5 is the highest affected 5.x line for either). (#105)
